body:
# 🐞 bug report ### Affected Package probably `core`, 9.1.9 ### Is this a regression? since 8 - yes, since 9.0 - maybe. Connected issue - https://github.com/angular/angular/issues/35231 As least I just migrated from 8.2.14 ### Description So, as in mentioned ticket 35231 the problem occurs when `ngOnDestroy` is called. Recently the context was changed, now it seems to be called on every instance in `multi` provision. Even when some of them does not implement `OnDestroy` (at least it looks so, but as you later will see - it does not fit to logic, context is changed again). Screenshot from chrome debugger when destroy was called (file `core.js`). ![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/17334466/83994077-a859e780-a955-11ea-8396-ba6ee6137626.png) The problem is - `RouteResultExternalLinksManager` does not implement `OnDestroy`, and because of that exception occurs: ![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/17334466/83994245-13a3b980-a956-11ea-97cb-5fe8ee8f5781.png) I would even say that `RouteResultExternalLinksManager` is not an instance of `Subscriber` as it looks like in debugger: ![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/17334466/83994288-36ce6900-a956-11ea-8bd7-a192da8548a2.png) ![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/17334466/83994304-3df57700-a956-11ea-9816-acae3bfa1000.png) ## 🔥 Exception or Error 

TypeError: this.clearSubscriptions is not a function
    at RouteResultExternalLinksManager.push.../../libs/imap/shared/flow-utils/subscriber.ts.Subscriber.ngOnDestroy (subscriber.ts:9)
    at executeOnDestroys (core.js:9522)
    at cleanUpView (core.js:9448)
    at destroyViewTree (core.js:9248)
    at destroyLView (core.js:9401)
    at RootViewRef.push.../../node_modules/@angular/core/__ivy_ngcc__/fesm5/core.js.ViewRef.destroy (core.js:10143)
    at ComponentRef.push.../../node_modules/@angular/core/__ivy_ngcc__/fesm5/core.js.ComponentRef.destroy (core.js:23229)
    at RouterOutlet.push.../../node_modules/@angular/router/__ivy_ngcc__/fesm5/router.js.RouterOutlet.deactivate (router.js:5355)
    at ActivateRoutes.push.../../node_modules/@angular/router/__ivy_ngcc__/fesm5/router.js.ActivateRoutes.deactivateRouteAndOutlet (router.js:2328)
    at ActivateRoutes.push.../../node_modules/@angular/router/__ivy_ngcc__/fesm5/router.js.ActivateRoutes.deactivateRouteAndItsChildren (router.js:2308)
